scope: One bounded story with three tasks and five criteria: rotate existing conversation segments on admitted mode changes in both delivery configurations, retain same-mode resume and existing recovery; safely resolve the existing task artifact directory and add brief-reading guidance to the common prompt; verify identities, invocation and prompt behavior with focused offline regressions. Current feature-spec.md and ARCH_REVIEW.md contain the concrete narrowed plan. No completed replacement proposal is submitted.
decisions: Owner requested simpler scope in run 0004 and approved replanning in run 0005. Preserve same-mode resumability, bounded comments, task/worktree/artifacts, approved frozen inputs and existing gates. Cover both adapters and delivery configurations. No new schema, persistent binding subsystem, generalized handoffs, protected-tree rollout or authentic-agent observation gate. Run 0006 asks only for a brief explanation; narrowed scope remains unchanged. Proposed detection compares the admitted next mode with the mode of the last actually used run in the candidate conversation segment; a difference allocates a fresh segment, while the same mode retains eligible resume. Refused or prelaunch attempts do not establish conversation use. Existing external delivery already incorporates mode into conversation identity; the change makes no-external-delivery selection consistent.
assumptions: Use existing identity-bound Plan session or rooted task artifact discovery across dates. Missing artifacts use ordinary setup; conflicting/unsafe paths must not invent continuity. Repository tests prove selection, invocation and prompt behavior, not model comprehension or live-provider behavior.
questions: No owner product questions. Publication blocker: current factory preflight rejects the one-story replacement with story US-001: preserve indexed and completed dependencies. The earlier US-001 through US-007 remain represented by the session index (#240–#246); omission is rejected and the current typed contract has no retirement intent. Required factory capability/input: supported reconciliation of superseded unfinished indexed stories, or a supported replacement operation and refreshed authoritative scope. Do not retain rejected old scope unchanged or invent no-op retirement stories. The current run cannot safely publish the simplified plan.
